column1: # Every bet actually placed in Session #6, from 2 Sep 2026 — PRE-ALFA 2, the long
# run: the engine and its rules are not touched while it runs.
# COLUMNS: fixture, rung, odds, side, cash-out multiple, probability
# override, note, STAKE. The stake is column 8 and is required — flat-unit
# ROI is stake-blind and stays right either way, but the money column is
# not, and stakes stopped being flat on 6 Sep when the size rose to 1.10.
# CONVENTION: a position struck AFTER kickoff must carry the words
# "in-play" in its note. The board reads that word to badge the card and
# to keep live strikes out of the board's own record — they are bought
# off a price the board never quoted and a score the engine cannot see.
# Record the score AT STRIKE only when it is known from the bettor or a
# timestamped slip: the score printed on a slip is the CURRENT one and
# says nothing about the moment the bet was struck.
# Earlier books are archived and deliberately not mixed in:
# The one carried-over settled row is Londrina v Juventude, kept by the bettor
# as the first row of this book.
# fixture   must match the fixture name in README.md's tables exactly; the
#           score, Tip 1 rung and Tip 1 probability are joined from there
# rung      the market ACTUALLY bought, which is often neither Tip 1 nor Tip 2
# side      H or A for a team total, - for a match total
# cashout   1 if the position was closed early; the ledger still scores the bet
#           as if held to full time, because that is what tests the tip
# p_override  the probability to price against, for a bet struck IN PLAY where
#           the pre-match number no longer describes it
